messages:

Subject: Onboarding: invoice delivery options and quick template question

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the warm welcome earlier — excited to get ClearInvoice live with Redwood. Two quick items from our ops team as we prepare to send the first invoices:

1) Portal vs email: we can push invoices through your portal (if you provision a supplier account) or email them to a billing address. Which do you prefer for initial go-live? If portal, please share the supplier invite link or the expected filename/field conventions we should match.

2) Template questions: we have a CSV/CSV+PDF workflow. Does AP require PO numbers embedded in the subject line (e.g., "PO-12345") and do you support multiple line items within a single invoice file?

I attached our standard sample invoice and the onboarding form so your team can confirm.

Attachments: clearinvoice_sample_invoice.pdf, vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

Thanks,
Sarah Holden
Head of Customer Billing
ClearInvoice Inc.
accounts@clearinvoice.com

From: olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-02T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice delivery options and quick template question

Hi Sarah — great to meet you.

Short answers up front: portal preferred for production; email allowed as a backstop. A couple more details below to make sure the first invoices land cleanly.

Portal details (preferred):
- We prefer supplier accounts in our portal for better tracing and automatic ack tokens. If you want to go this route, reply with the onboarding contact and I'll send the invite.
- Filename: prefer invoice_<supplierid>_<invoice_date>.pdf or invoice_<PO#>_<invoice#>.pdf (either is fine).
- Required fields: supplier name, invoice number, invoice date, total, currency, and PO number (if applicable). Line items OK in CSV or embedded PDF with machine-readable table.

Email fallback (if portal not possible initially):
- Send to billing+invoices@redwood.com.
- Subject convention: "INV | PO-<PONUMBER> | <SUPPLIERNAME>" — PO in subject helps our AP matcher. If multiple POs on one invoice, include the primary PO in subject and list others in the invoice body.
- We will parse CSV attachments and PDFs; please prefer CSV when you can.

Questions for you:
- Do you need a reserved PO start date? (some vendors want to wait until POs are fully stood up).
- Are you sending consolidated invoices that include multiple POs per file? If yes, confirm how line items map to PO numbers (column name you use).

I've attached our vendor_onboarding_form and a short AP checklist (AP onboarding checklist link below) — Monica here will confirm a couple of mapping rules with you.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf
Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AP/Onboarding/ClearInvoice-Checklist

Best,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Hi Olga / Monica,

Thanks for the clear guidance. A few clarifications from our side:
- We can be live on the portal by EOD Friday if you send the invite. Please create the supplier id as "CLEARINV-RED" if possible (helps our internal routing).
- We typically consolidate weekly into a single CSV that can contain multiple PO references. The CSV uses a "PO_NUMBER" column and a "LINE_TOTAL" column — we'll attach a sample CSV.
- We'll default to CSV + human-readable PDF. For email fallback we'll use the subject convention you suggested.

Attached: sample_invoice_template.csv (CSV stub)

One ask: does Redwood's AP system tolerate multiple currency lines in the same file? We sometimes bill in USD and EUR on the same file when we manage multi-entity customers.

Cheers,
The ClearInvoice onboarding team

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: ClearInvoice Onboarding <onboarding@clearinvoice.com>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: invoice delivery options and quick template question

Thanks team — quick AP confirmation from our side:

1) Portal: please proceed. Olga, I'm happy to send the invite (I will use supplier id CLEARINV-RED). Once the account is active the portal will return an ack token in the UI and via webhooks if you opt in.

2) CSV template: your PO_NUMBER and LINE_TOTAL columns are exactly what our ingestion expects. If you include a currency column we will honor it; multi-currency rows are accepted but we strongly prefer single-currency files per invoice to avoid FX reconciliation headaches. If you must mix currencies, include a column named "CURRENCY" and we will flag the invoice for manual review (this may delay payment by 3-5 business days).

3) Subject & PO handling on email fallback: use the subject pattern "INV | PO-<PONUMBER> | CLEARINVOICE". If consolidating multiple POs in one file, include a CSV column "PO_NUMBER" listing the PO per line; we match on PO_NUMBER for automated posting.

4) Additional: please confirm whether you will send tax/VAT amounts as separate columns ("TAX_AMOUNT") or embedded in line totals. Separate columns preferred.

Next steps: Sarah — once you confirm CSV column names and whether you will split currencies, Olga will send the portal invite and we'll schedule a 20-min handoff call to verify sample parsing on our end.

Attachment: ap_onboarding_checklist.xlsx

Regards,
Monica Patel
AP Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
